name: Code Your Own SPICE (Python circuit simulator)

mentions.name: Code Your Own SPICE (Python circuit simulator)
mentions.description: A home-built electronic circuit simulator (a 'code your own SPICE') written in Python that lets users represent and code circuits in Python instead of wrestling with heavy math. It provides a formal language for circuits and helped the builder finally understand how circuits work and how they are designed.
mentions.problem: Electronics never clicked because the math in books like AoE couldn't be intuitively grasped; what was needed was a formal language to represent circuits rather than more maths.
mentions.source_excerpt: So over the past few weeks, I worked on a code your own spice (the electronic simulator). So now, for the first time in history, I finally understand how circuits work and how they are designed. And I did this all by coding circuits in python and making my own functional spice
